item.title: THE END IS IN SIGHT, WARNS SUTTON
item.description: CHRIS SUTTON reckons the end is in sight for Wilfried Nancy at Celtic. After just two weeks – and four soul-destroying defeats – the support turned on the Frenchman as the champions carelessly threw away three points after leading at the interval against struggling Dundee United at Tannadice last night. item.title: LET’S WORK TOGETHER: BERNARDO’S RALLYING CRY
item.description: PAULO BERNARDO insists the Celtic players must accept responsibility to help turn around the fortunes of the champions. item.title: CELTIC’S QUADRUPLE HEROES: WHERE ARE THEY NOW?
item.description: NEIL LENNON utilised 17 players when Celtic claimed a unique place in Scottish football history by sealing the phenomenal quadruple treble – exactly FIVE years ago today.
